preconditions.description: The input must be provided via standard input.
The number of nodes in the binary tree must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.data <= 10**5 for node in nodes)
preconditions.description: Each node's data must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the products of each node and its mirror image, computed modulo 10^9 + 7.
